subject: Urgent: inbound trailer TR-3456 reroute — reduced dock window
messages:
From: ForwardTransit Logistics <ops@forwardtransit.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: inbound trailer TR-3456 reroute — reduced dock window

Hi Rachel / Tessa —

Quick heads up: the driver assigned to trailer TR-3456 en route to Nexus Events experienced an incident on I-880 this morning. The carrier is diverting the trailer to an alternate receiving site (Warehouse 7) due to a staging restriction at the originally planned dock.

We expect a revised ETA of 09:30 local and the carrier notes Warehouse 7 only has a 2-hour dock window this morning (09:00–11:00) for drop acceptance. We are attaching the current BOL and manifest (see attachment stubs).

Attachment stubs: BOL_TR-3456.pdf, Inbound_Manifest_TR-3456.xlsx

Please confirm acceptance at Warehouse 7 or advise an alternate receiving plan. If Warehouse 7 cannot accept within that window, the trailer will be held at a yard which will add a re-stow fee and could jeopardize load-in timelines for the booth.

—Amir
ForwardTransit Logistics
ops@forwardtransit.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: ForwardTransit Logistics <ops@forwardtransit.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Nexus Events <events@nexusevents.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T08:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: inbound trailer TR-3456 reroute — reduced dock window

Amir — thanks for the quick update. Two asks:

1) Can you push an updated BOL that shows Warehouse 7 as the consignee and provide the carrier POC + phone / driver name ASAP? We need paperwork for their receiving window.

2) Tessa / Jonas — Warehouse 7 is new to our plan; can you confirm whether we can accept a partial early drop there (09:30) and whether our onsite crew can meet the trailer or if we need a bonded transfer to the event site? Marissa — flagging potential for re-stow fees and possible kit shortages.

If Warehouse 7 cannot confirm acceptance, instruct carrier to stage at nearest secure yard and alert me immediately — we will escalate to Nexus to see if they can extend the dock window.

I am attaching the inbound manifest we have on file (Inbound_Manifest_TR-3456.xlsx) to speed reconciliation.

Thanks —
Rachel
Senior Events Ops, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.ai

From: Warehouse 7 Receiving <receiving@wh7.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, ForwardTransit Logistics <ops@forwardtransit.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Urgent: inbound trailer TR-3456 reroute — reduced dock window

Rachel / Amir —

Warehouse 7 can accept TR-3456 but only within a tight slot: 09:00–11:00 today. We require a pre-alert with driver name, carrier MC#, and an electronic BOL (PDF) at least 30 minutes prior to arrival. We also need the following completed intake form (attached): Warehouse7_Receiving_Instructions.pdf.

Note: if the trailer contains crates larger than 48" we will need a lift-team on arrival (our dock can handle standard pallet/crate sized skids only). If oversized, please advise immediately so we can schedule additional lift crews (+$150/hr).

Contact: Martin Delgado, Receiving Supervisor — (415) 555-0123
receiving@wh7.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: ForwardTransit Logistics <ops@forwardtransit.com>, Warehouse 7 Receiving <receiving@wh7.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: inbound trailer TR-3456 reroute — reduced dock window

Thanks Martin / Amir. We will accept at Warehouse 7 for the 09:30 appointment but need the electronic BOL and the carrier/driver details 30+ minutes prior to arrival as requested.

Operational notes from our side:
- Our onsite crew will meet the trailer at Warehouse 7 and do a quick triage for show-critical kits only (podium, AV rack, branded counters). Anything non-critical will be cross-docked to a short-term storage location and delivered to the event site during the afternoon slot.
- If there are oversized crates, we will confirm immediately and cover the lift-team charge if unavoidable; please notify if any crate dimensions exceed 48" x 48" x 72".
- Please confirm that the manifest matches the BOL you will send; if there are any SKUs missing we need line-level visibility before arrival.

We will absorb reasonable re-stow costs caused by the carrier diversion but will escalate to Nexus if additional vendor charges threaten the load-in schedule.

Jonas Weber
Logistics Lead, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
